description: Per-target overlay read by scripts/build-manifests.sh. Identity (name, description, author, homepage, repository, license, keywords, skills) comes from .claude-plugin/plugin.json and the version from plugin-version.json; this file carries only what one target adds or overrides. A target's `description` replaces the canonical one; `keywords_exclude` removes canonical keywords that name another host; a `skills` key set to null is filled with the canonical skills list at that position. Regenerate every manifest with `bash scripts/build-manifests.sh .`; CI runs `--check`.

agent_plugins.emit_codex_extension_note: false until a live Codex run proves the root-manifest route finds the skills: with extensions.com.openai present, Codex >= 0.147 ignores .codex-plugin/plugin.json entirely and hard-codes ./skills as the one skills root, and the Agent Plugins spec scans only immediate children of skills/ while this repo nests them two levels deep. With the switch off, Codex falls back to .codex-plugin/plugin.json and its seven explicit skill roots, which is the route that is known to load; the generated Codex hooks file reaches Codex either way. Flip to true, regenerate, and record the live run in platform-targets.json.

GITHUB_TOKEN.title: GitHub token for the bundled github MCP server
GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional. A GitHub personal access token with repo scope. Set it under Plugins > Configure; it is handed to the github MCP server as GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN and nothing else reads it. Leave it unset to keep the server off - it refuses to start without one.

gemini.description: Multi-platform agent plugin: worktree-based dev workflow, repo standards, and MCP tooling. Skills install separately (see docs/user/install/gemini.md).

settings.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
settings.description: GitHub personal access token (repo scope) for the bundled github MCP server. Stored in the system keychain and handed to scripts/github-mcp.sh as GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN; nothing else in the extension reads it. Leave it empty to keep the server off - it refuses to start without one.

gemini.settings_note: `settings` is Gemini's userConfig analogue: `sensitive: true` stores the value in the OS keychain and `envVar` is the variable the extension's MCP servers receive (measured on 0.64.0: getExtensionEnvironment feeds MCP transports only, not hooks). Set it with `gemini extensions config tamirs-superpowers GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN`. No `excludeTools`: nothing this plugin ships needs a core tool removed, and an exclusion would apply to every session the extension is enabled in.

antigravity.description: Antigravity CLI plugin folder (platforms/antigravity/), generated by scripts/build-antigravity-plugin.sh. plugin.json is a CLOSED schema ({name, description}, additionalProperties false), so identity fields other than these two are not emitted; mcp_config.json carries the github stdio server.
antigravity.plugin_description: 30 bundled skills, 10 specialist agents, worktree workflow and MCP server stubs - plan, implement, review, debug, multi-agent setup, and audit code from one plugin.
antigravity.mcp_note: Antigravity documents stdio servers as {command, args, env, cwd} with absolute example paths and no plugin-root placeholder; whether a relative command path resolves against the plugin directory is UNVERIFIED (no agy binary was available). `agy plugin import gemini` from an installed Gemini extension is the route known to produce absolute paths.
